! JO9 MOD START MERCY_ALLURE_20261113_HELPER if $args[0] = 'help': $result = '[매력 TIPS]
 매력은 현재의 자비로운 평판에 따라 달라집니다. 자비 수치가 높아지면 등급이 오르고, 낮아지면 등급도 내려갑니다.
매력은 노예의 반응과 대인 거래에 영향을 줍니다.' exit end local jo9_mercy_points2 = 2*jo9_cruel_mercy + jo9_cruel_mercy_half result = 0 if jo9_mercy_points2 >= 10: result = 1 if jo9_mercy_points2 >= 30: result = 2 if jo9_mercy_points2 >= 50: result = 3 if jo9_mercy_points2 >= 80: result = 4 if jo9_mercy_points2 >= 120: result = 5 ! JO9 MOD END MERCY_ALLURE_20261113_HELPER

!style update after hygiene, energy and mood updates (above) and before updating master_supermacy (below) - ImperatorAugustus
master_style = 2 + style_modifer[$master_cloth] - max(0, master_hygiene - 2)
if master_hygiene = 0: master_style += 1
if master_energy > 0: master_style += 1
if master_energy < 0: master_style -= 1
if master_visage > 0: master_style += 1
if master_visage = 0: master_style -= 1
if master_haircut > 0: master_style += 1
if master_haircut = 0: master_style -= 1
if master_str > 3: master_style += 1
if master_str < 3: master_style -= 1
if master_mood > 0: master_style += 1
if master_mood < 0: master_style -= 1
if master_style > 5: master_style = 5
if master_style < 0: master_style = 0

! JO9 MOD START CRUEL_MERCY_RULES_20261101
! Delta is in half-points. Missing legacy remainder reads as zero.
local jo9_cm_total = 2 * jo9_cruel_mercy + jo9_cruel_mercy_half + args[0]
if jo9_cm_total < 0:
 jo9_cruel_mercy = -((-jo9_cm_total) / 2)
else
 jo9_cruel_mercy = jo9_cm_total / 2
end
jo9_cruel_mercy_half = jo9_cm_total - 2 * jo9_cruel_mercy
! JO9 MOD END CRUEL_MERCY_RULES_20261101
